title: Has anybody been to " farm world"?
content: Last night I dreamed I was jogging this trail that went through farmland and cut through various barns and outbuildings. Like you'd go in one door and right out another. I had a sense that I had been there before and I got to a point where I reached a fenced in area and I got worried about trespassing so I decided to turn back. There was no one there when I first ran through but on the way back I started seeing other people. I also had a sense I was somewhat invisible and the people couldn't really see me. They looked ghostlike to me too. One of them did see me and yelled in surprise but I kept going because the feeling like I wasn't supposed to be there intensified. And that's when I woke up.
